_iot_endpoint_note: Set this to your AWS IoT data endpoint, or export PIHOME_IOT_ENDPOINT. Find it with: aws iot describe-endpoint --endpoint-type iot:Data-ATS. Left null deliberately - an endpoint belongs to one AWS account, so there is no sensible default to ship.
_comment: The fleet registry. Device identity lives here, not in code. A web UI reads this to render the device list before any MQTT message arrives. Every node is currently unprovisioned: the fleet is being stood up on a new AWS account, and nothing has a certificate yet. Set provisioned to true as each one connects. Hardware-to-device mapping is inferred from what each script drives and has NOT been confirmed against the physical Pis - verify before relying on it.
